proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
  intro N inst hN
  classical
  obtain ⟨hleft, hright⟩ := M8.MixedFamily.literal_polynomials N hN
  have hc : (1 + 1 : Polynomial (ZMod 2)) = 0 := by
    simpa only [map_add, map_one, map_zero] using
      congrArg (fun c : ZMod 2 => Polynomial.C c)
        (show (1 + 1 : ZMod 2) = 0 by decide)
  have hn : -(1 : Polynomial (ZMod 2)) = 1 := by
    apply neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr
    exact hc
  have ham : M8.MixedFamily.a ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N := by
    have hd := sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow (Polynomial.X : Polynomial (ZMod 2)) 1 N
    simpa [M8.MixedFamily.a, M6.Cyclic.modulus, sub_eq_add_neg, hn, add_comm] using hd
  have hab : M8.MixedFamily.a ∣ M8.MixedFamily.b := by
    rw [M8.MixedFamily.algebra.1]
    exact dvd_pow_self _ (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)
  have ha : M8.MixedFamily.a.Monic := by
    simpa [M8.MixedFamily.a, add_comm] using
      (Polynomial.monic_X_add_C (1 : ZMod 2))
  have hs := (M7.RecipeSignature.signature_properties N (M8.MixedFamily.recipe N)).1
  have hsa : M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M8.MixedFamily.recipe N) ∣ M8.MixedFamily.a := by
    unfold M7.RecipeSignature.signature
    dsimp only [M8.MixedFamily.recipe]
    rw [hleft, hright]
    first
    | change gcd (gcd M8.MixedFamily.a M8.MixedFamily.b) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) ∣ M8.MixedFamily.a
      exact dvd_trans (gcd_dvd_left _ _) (gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    | change gcd M8.MixedFamily.a (gcd M8.MixedFamily.b (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)) ∣ M8.MixedFamily.a
      exact gcd_dvd_left _ _
    | change gcd (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (gcd M8.MixedFamily.a M8.MixedFamily.b) ∣ M8.MixedFamily.a
      exact dvd_trans (gcd_dvd_right _ _) (gcd_dvd_left _ _)
  have has : M8.MixedFamily.a ∣ M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M8.MixedFamily.recipe N) := by
    unfold M7.RecipeSignature.signature
    dsimp only [M8.MixedFamily.recipe]
    rw [hleft, hright]
    first
    | change M8.MixedFamily.a ∣ gcd (gcd M8.MixedFamily.a M8.MixedFamily.b) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)
      exact dvd_gcd (dvd_gcd (dvd_refl _) hab) ham
    | change M8.MixedFamily.a ∣ gcd M8.MixedFamily.a (gcd M8.MixedFamily.b (M6.Cyclic.modulus N))
      exact dvd_gcd (dvd_refl _) (dvd_gcd hab ham)
    | change M8.MixedFamily.a ∣ gcd (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (gcd M8.MixedFamily.a M8.MixedFamily.b)
      exact dvd_gcd ham (dvd_gcd (dvd_refl _) hab)
  symm
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le_of_leadingCoeff has
  · exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hsa ha.ne_zero
  · rw [ha.leadingCoeff, hs.leadingCoeff]
